notes.title: IMMURE v1.1.2 patch notes
notes.content:
Enhancements:
- Added in "Title Cards" that now play when the player enters a chapter location for the first time

Fixes:
- Fixed issue where the VSYNC setting in video options was not properly displaying the user's selected settings
- Fixed/adjusted some text mistakes in dialogue and other areas of the game
- Fixed bug where, if you chose the wrong shell during the shell game, Johnny would sometimes say the shell you just chose had the key in it even though it did not
- Fixed some clues in the Residence that were using the wrong images which was preventing the player from being able to read their associated text
- Fixed issue where teleportation lions were not usable after returning back to the Mansion from the Residence
- Fixed issue where dropping items next to one of the two sisters in the Residence prevent the player from picking the item back up
- Removed Brazilian Portuguese from being a selectable translation option (this translation was never done and should never have been selectable)

Other Notes:
- Russian translation is in the works, this build does have a partial translation but we highly recommend you wait for the next patch which will feature the full translation!

notes.title: IMMURE News: Part Two Release Date and Part One Goes Free!
notes.content:
Today we are happy to announce that IMMURE: Part Two will be releasing on December 17th! 

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149270/IMMURE_Part_Two/
[previewyoutube=1aEFcIW_1Bk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Part One is Going Free on December 17th[/b]
We like to be transparent with our fans and want to give everyone ample notice before the change happens. To be honest, we’ve struggled with exposure for IMMURE and we’d like to give it the best chance we can. After recommendations by other devs, talking with fans on Discord, and many internal discussions, we’ve decided that making Part One free and releasing the subsequent parts as paid DLC could help to bring more players onboard.

Many thanks to everyone who has supported us this far. It truly means the world to our team. We hope that everyone is well and staying safe during this chaotic year.

Love,
Wither Studios

notes.title: Part One News
notes.content:
Greetings everyone, we’re updating to let you all know that IMMURE: Part One is planned to be released on May 9th here on Steam! We added more content pertaining to story and extra polish to almost every discoverable area of the game. We’ve had closed beta testers help us get our game ready for release so a huge shoutout to those testers from our discord who took part in our testing.

Our plan for IMMURE is to release two parts initially. Each part will be sold separately, the second of which as DLC. We have crafted the way in which to wrap up the story enough to be a conclusion. If the response is really positive on these released parts, we would like to release subsequent DLC-style chapters that would extend IMMURE’s story in satisfying ways.


That’s it for now. Be sure to wishlist IMMURE and stay tuned for more info soon!

Your friends,
-Wither Team

notes.title: Post Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

With our Kickstarter failing to reach our funding goal, we have decided to shift IMMURE to be structured in a chapter based format. Our plan is to polish and add additional content to the Apartment, and then release that as our first chapter. This will allow us to start building funds to complete the following chapters. This also means we will be shortening the demo so that it provides a taste of the horror of IMMURE as opposed to containing an entire chapter as it currently does.

If you wish to support the development of IMMURE, then please show support by purchasing the first chapter when we release it! Stay tuned for more information by following us on social media.

- Wither Team

notes.title: Mac and Linux Support for the Demo!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33521691/45849152a967b1b0d3c77b0bfe2c627766893d25.png[/img]

Announcing the release of the demo on both Mac and Linux! Sorry for the delayed release but we certainly didn't forget about you guys! Going forward, all platforms will continue to receive general updates so nobody will be left behind. We are a small team with limited resources, so if anybody has any issues with any of the platforms then we ask that you report these issues and please be patient while we look into them. 

Thanks for all of the support from everybody, the response has been amazing and we love hearing what everybody has to say! We have been working hard on this for so long that it honestly seems almost surreal to finally have it out there. However, there still is the rest of the game to be made so please help us spread the word about our upcoming Kickstarter on October 15th to fund full development!

Hi everyone!

The IMMURE Demo is now available!

This demo is roughly the first hour of the game. We, Wither Studios, have been working on this demo for the past 3.5 years, as indies. We believe in this game, but we wanted to prove that to you all before launching our Kickstarter campaign on October 15th. It’s a gamble, but if we’re going to ask for your support for our campaign, we want you to believe in our abilities to create a great horror game!

Currently, only the Windows version is available but Mac and Linux support will be coming soon!  Let us know what you think of the demo! And please, share the news with your friends!

Join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/YGqJCJ2]discord[/url] while we build our community and speak to us directly! If you run into any bugs or issues then let us know in discord or reach out to our programmer, Mike, at mikethomas@witherstudios.com.

Thanks for playing!
